title: The Thief's Stone
journal: Never-Writes-Twice sent me after the three seal-stones. A dead thief's stone lies in the warden's vault at Blackrose Prison, whose people, the Blackguards' heirs, attack strangers on sight. Their gate-captain stands outside the gate. I'm to get in: as a guest past the gate-captain (a toll, words or a duel), unseen past the walls, or by force.
objectives: Get into Blackrose Prison; the gate-captain stands at the gate. (marker: Corvus Ulvius, Blackrose Prison)

plan.going: I am a Reel-Ka of the Toh-Reel-Ka, hunting the three seal-stones that open the kings' gate at Teku-Sul before the Unbound get them. One lies in the warden's vault in Blackrose Prison. The prison's people attack strangers.
plan.next: get into the prison; the gate-captain outside the gate is the first person to deal with
plan.ways: pay the gate-captain 300 gold, persuade him (Speech 75) or duel him until he yields: each makes me a guest, and the garrison stops attacking me; or slip past the walls unseen (Sneak, Invisibility), and they attack if they see me; or fight my way in (any fighting skill), and the whole garrison fights me

answers: I work for the Toh-Reel-Ka (Never-Writes-Twice is my officer). The Hist trees are sick, and the Unbound are draining sap. To use the Eye of Argonia at the Root I must open the gate at Teku-Sul Spire, which needs three seal-stones. This one is the thief stone in the warden vault at Blackrose Prison.
Get into Blackrose Prison past the gate-captain Corvus Ulvius, then reach the raj-kaal Okaz-Teel in Raj-Kaal Hall, who has the vault key on his belt.

Pay 300 gold toll, persuade him with words, duel him (fists and steel until one yields), or climb the walls unseen (risky), or fight everyone by force. Killing Corvus means the whole Rose fights me. I favour force/duel.
I do not know what the Imperial in the hall is, who the buyer is, or what is in the vault exactly. I can find out by talking to Corvus and going inside.

title: The Thief's Stone
journal: Corvus Ulvius, the gate-captain, took up my challenge. He fights until he is badly hurt and then yields. If he yields, I go in as a guest. If I kill him, the whole garrison will fight me. I'm to beat him.
objectives: Beat Corvus Ulvius in the duel until he yields. (marker: Corvus Ulvius)

plan.going: I challenged the gate-captain to a duel to get in as a guest
plan.ways: when he yields I am a guest; if I kill him instead, the garrison fights me

answers: Same mission for the Toh-Reel-Ka: get the thief seal-stone from Blackrose. Corvus accepted my duel; he fights until badly hurt, then yields and I enter as a guest.
Beat Corvus at the gate without killing him.
Fight him and win (he yields), or lose and reload; I could also have paid or persuaded, but I chose the duel. Killing him would bring the whole garrison.
Nothing new that I do not understand, except the Imperial buyer inside.

title: The Thief's Stone
journal: Corvus Ulvius is dead, and the Blackguards' heirs are fighting me. The vault's key is on Okaz-Teel, the Naga raj-kaal, in his hall across the yard. I'm to fight through to him and take the key from his body, or pick the vault's Expert lock.
objectives: Take the seal-stone from the Warden's Vault in Okaz-Teel's hall. (marker: Okaz-Teel, Door to Warden's Vault)

plan.next: get the key from Okaz-Teel in his hall, or pick the vault
plan.ways: fight the guards and the chief and take the key from his body, or pick the Expert lock

answers: I killed Corvus instead of making him yield, so the whole garrison of Blackguards heirs now fights me. I still work for the Toh-Reel-Ka and need the thief seal-stone from the Warden vault.
Fight through the yard to Okaz-Teel in his hall, take the vault key from him, and open the Warden Vault door for the stone.
Kill Okaz-Teel for the key, or pick the vault Expert lock.
I do not know what the Imperial buyer wants or how strong the garrison is; I will see inside.

title: The Thief's Stone
journal: I took the thief's seal-stone from the warden's vault in Blackrose Prison. Two stones are still out, in the flooded vaults of Gemin and the deepest hall of Vorannuhl, and both are still marked. I'm to take them.

plan.going: I took the thief's seal-stone from the warden's vault in Blackrose Prison. Two stones are still out, in the flooded vaults of Gemin and the deepest hall of Vorannuhl, and both are still marked. I'm to take them.
plan.next: nothing more in this quest; the next quests entry carries the step

answers: I got the thief seal-stone from the Warden Vault at Blackrose, after killing Corvus, Okaz-Teel and fighting the heirs. One of three stones for the Teku-Sul Spire gate, so the Eye can heal the Hist.
Fetch the other two: Gemin flooded vaults (walk from Jal-Veesa, rootworm) and Vorannuhl deepest hall (boat to Noota Nara). Then take all to the Spire.
I still do not know what Ennodius Vanin the Collector will do, or what moans in Fort Chalkmoth cellar.
